string.text: A large mutant migration is moving from Garbage toward Rostok. Meet all three packs at the southern checkpoint before they reach the Bar.
Destroy three mutant packs at Rostok's southern checkpoint.
The southern approach is secure again.
Several Monolith squads broke through the Barrier and are pushing toward Rostok from Army Warehouses. Stop them at the northern checkpoint.
Destroy three Monolith squads at Rostok's northern checkpoint.
None of them reached the Bar. The line held.
Bandit assault groups are moving against the southern checkpoint. Engage them outside before the garrison is pinned at the gates.
Repel the bandit raid on Rostok.
The raid died at the gate.
